description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

Completely removes a letter from production. This can only be done if the letter has a `send_date` and the `send_date` has not yet passed. If the letter is successfully canceled, you will not be charged for it. Read more on [cancellation windows](#section/Cancellation-Windows) and [scheduling](#section/Scheduled-Mailings). Scheduling and cancellation is a premium feature. Upgrade to the appropriate Print & Mail Edition to gain access.
